amends: grokbot/redteam/protocols/v0.0.20.json (sha256 18cf2ef5...) - adds two REPORTS; changes no gate, no decision
owner_requirements: gb_feedback_1005/1030: report a round-robin Elo/ladder vs ALL prior frozen versions (v0.0.11..v0.0.19) to catch non-transitive cycling, and a check that league games are not degenerate (draw/stall rate, game length)
registered_before: pushed while the v0.0.20 league was running and before any of its output was read

players.v0.0.20: kind group_pd, the v0.0.20 league champion (report['league']['archive'][champion])

ladder.aliases: players with identical (kind, params) are played once under the earliest name; aliases listed in the report
ladder.games: round robin over distinct players; seeds 9000-9005, both sides (12 games per pairing); selfplay.play_game at RangeBoxingEnv(0.5 m, 3000 ticks), anti-stalling, ending v2; eval noise 0.05
ladder.ratings: grokbot.league.Ledger.ratings(anchor='v0.0.11') (Bradley-Terry on the Elo scale, draw = half) and bootstrap_ratings (200 samples, 95%)
ladder.cycling: pairwise score = mean utility over valid games; count intransitive triads (a beats b, b beats c, c beats a, each with nonzero score); list them
ladder.degeneracy: per pairing and overall: valid / no-contest / blocked / engine-fault shares and median end tick

league_degeneracy: from the v0.0.20 league report: per generation training valid share, training median end tick, evaluation valid / no-contest shares, engaged share
decision: reporting only; v0.0.20 level_up stays exactly as registered in v0.0.20.json
